headline: One in three young Britons have never had s*x, major Lancet study finds
label: VIRAL
caption:
Britain's young people are having far less s*x than any generation before them 📉

One in three Britons aged 16 to 24 say they have never had s*x, according to the fourth National Survey of S*xual Attitudes and Lifestyles (Natsal 4), published in The Lancet. That is up from around one in five between 1990 and 2010.

The study surveyed about 6,700 people across England, Scotland and Wales between September 2022 and January 2024. Among under 25s, 38 percent of women and 28 percent of men reported never having had intercourse.

Adults under 45 now report having s*x about twice a month on average, half the rate of four times a month recorded in 1990. Researchers point to more time spent online, young people living longer with their parents and a stronger focus on consent as possible reasons.
